August 1, 1990

MEMORANDUM

TO: Pat Wilson
Philip Morris USA

FROM: Bill Trisler
The Tobacco Institute

RE: Alderman Burke's Proposed Ordinance - Chicago, IL

Pat, enclosed is a copy of the minutes of the above-mentioned. This was hand carried to TI on this date so that Covington and Burling and our Public Affairs Department can study the contents of the questions and answers. I thought you might like a copy to evaluate. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to call.
